title: Robot reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Robot body -->
  <rect x="30" y="55" width="40" height="35" rx="5" fill="#5B9BD5"/>
  <rect x="35" y="60" width="30" height="25" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- Robot head -->
  <rect x="28" y="20" width="44" height="34" rx="6" fill="#6BB5E0"/>
  <rect x="33" y="24" width="34" height="26" rx="4" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <!-- Eyes on screen -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="35" r="4" fill="#00FFCC"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="35" r="4" fill="#00FFCC"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="35" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="35" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Cute smile on screen -->
  <path d="M43 43 Q50 48 57 43" stroke="#00FFCC" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Antenna -->
  <line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="10" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="4" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <rect x="18" y="62" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="68" y="62" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- Hands -->
  <circle cx="17" cy="65" r="4" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="65" r="4" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g transform="translate(50,80)">
    <!-- Left page -->
    <path d="M-2,0 L-22,-8 L-22,6 L-2,14 Z" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
    <path d="M-3,1 L-21,-6 L-21,5 L-3,12 Z" fill="#FFE8CC"/>
    <!-- Right page -->
    <path d="M2,0 L22,-8 L22,6 L2,14 Z" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
    <path d="M3,1 L21,-6 L21,5 L3,12 Z" fill="#FFE8CC"/>
    <!-- Spine -->
    <line x1="0" y1="-1" x2="0" y2="13" stroke="#FF6B6B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Book cover edges -->
    <path d="M-22,-8 L-24,-7 L-24,7 L-22,6 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
    <path d="M22,-8 L24,-7 L24,7 L22,6 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
    <!-- Text lines on pages -->
    <line x1="-18" y1="-3" x2="-6" y2="1" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="-18" y1="1" x2="-6" y2="5" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="-18" y1="5" x2="-6" y2="9" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="6" y1="1" x2="18" y2="-3" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="6" y1="5" x2="18" y2="1" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="6" y1="9" x2="18" y2="5" stroke="#D4A574" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Light glow around book -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="28" ry="18" fill="#FFE8CC" opacity="0.15"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x="35" y="90" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <rect x="53" y="90" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
</svg>
